capabilities: render termlogue code blocks as animated terminal sessions
control playback with play, pause, restart and 1x/2x/4x/Instant speeds
copy the block's command lines to the clipboard
restyle terminals with five built-in themes via @theme
disambiguation: Not a terminal emulator or shell runner; commands are never executed and the block is display-only.
extras: Manual installation only until accepted into the community plugin browser. In Obsidian, Reading View is supported; Live Preview renders the block as an ordinary code fence. The Marp Presenter companion is desktop-only and requires Node plus Marp CLI. Extensive Security section stresses that nothing is executed and no network requests are made.
problem: Markdown code blocks containing shell sessions are static text, so demonstrating a CLI workflow requires embedding a screencast or GIF instead.

relations.evidence: Terminalogue plugs into Marp CLI as an engine
an Obsidian companion plugin, Terminalogue Presenter, that turns the note you are looking at into one
Terminalogue extends the built-in Markdown preview; there is no custom preview or webview

summary: Renders termlogue code blocks as animated terminal sessions with themes, playback controls and copyable commands, without ever executing the commands.
